document:0:178:0.text:
The experiment is almost complete, but it's not perfect yet...
Be that as it may, I haven't come up with any new ideas lately. Guess I just have to put the experiment on hold for now.
Lately, I keep having dreams about my forest being discovered by others... Instead of fearing it...
Why not prepare for it in advance and leave some rewards for whoever finds it?
Hmm, what kind of rewards should I prepare? And how do I give them hints?

All set! Here's my plan for now: the flying squirrel will be the guide, while the hopping mushroom sprites will show the correct directions...
It's both mysterious and fun!
Firstly, I need to come up with a chant that summons the hopping mushroom sprites...
<style="highlight">"Mushroom sprite! Hopping is alright!"</style> This sounds good!
My design's so cool! This way, if I ever forget the location, I'll be able to find the forest again!
I'm the youngest high priest in Sal'thorin, after all!
<align="right">By Feli</align>
document:0:178:0.source_cn:
实验进行的差不多了，但还不够完美……
不过我最近也没更多思路了，先暂缓一下吧！
最近老是做梦梦到林地被人发现……既然如此——
不如顺其自然，给发现林地的人小奖励！
唔，奖励什么呢？怎么提示呢？

（中间空白了好长一段）

全部搞定！目前的方案就是让小飞鼠带路，再找蹦蹦菇灵指引方向……
既有保密性，又有趣！
唔，我得先给蹦蹦菇灵设计一个召唤咒语……
就这个啦——<style="highlight">菇灵菇灵快快来！蹦！</style>
感觉这个设计超棒的！这样就算我忘记位置，也能找到宝物啦！
不愧是我，萨洛克兰最年轻的高级祭司！
<align="right">——斐利尔</align>

say:2:1421231001:0.text: This is exactly the type of thing Master Feli would come up with...
say:2:1421231001:0.source_cn: 真像是斐利尔大人会想出来的方法……

say:3:1421231002:0.text: Feli always made simple things so complicated.
say:3:1421231002:0.source_cn: 斐利尔真是……每次都把简单的事情弄得这么复杂。

say:4:1421231003:0.text: In order to find this treasure, we need a hopping mushroom sprite that will guide us...
say:4:1421231003:0.source_cn: 宝藏会被施加魔法的蹦蹦菇灵指引嘛……

say:5:1421231004:0.text: This is going to be an interesting journey.
say:5:1421231004:0.source_cn: 看来我们要跟着蹦蹦菇灵，走一段有趣的路了。

choice_prompt:6:1421231004.text: This is going to be an interesting journey.
choice_prompt:6:1421231004.source_cn: 看来我们要跟着附近的孢子，走一段有趣的路了。

say:7:1421231005:0.text: I-I can't wait either. I'm alright now and ready to go.
say:7:1421231005:0.source_cn: 我、我也是！我已经又振作起来了。

say:8:1421231006:0.text: Let's find this hopping mushroom sprite.
say:8:1421231006:0.source_cn: 两位大人，我们快去找特殊的蹦蹦菇灵吧！
say:8:1421231006:0.male: Let's find this hopping mushroom sprite.
say:8:1421231006:0.female: Let's find this hopping mushroom sprite.

say:9:1421231007:0.text: Remember. We need to say, "Mushroom sprite! Hopping is alright!"
say:9:1421231007:0.source_cn: 记得念出——“菇灵菇灵快快来！蹦！”

say:10:1421231008:0.text: You know what, Liv? I'll give you the honor of chanting that.
